issue_context.title: [BUG] `expect.not` is missing in @playwright/test type definition
issue_context.body:
**Context:**
- Playwright Version: 1.22.0
- Operating System: macOS
- Node.js version: 16.13.1
- Browser: Electron 18.0.3
- Extra: Confirmed via code inspection.

**Code Snippet**

```typescript
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';

test('should compile', () => {
  expect('hello world').toEqual(expect.not.stringContaining('text'));
});
```

**Describe the bug**

`expect.not` should exist, per [Jest docs](https://jestjs.io/docs/expect#expectnotstringcontainingstring).
However, it's not declared in the TypeScript definition in this repository:
https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/e5cf11cb68f89c270aed283b1d46ea59ff770833/packages/playwright-test/types/test.d.ts#L2958

There appears to be a `expect.poll().not`, if I'm reading the code correctly:
https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/e5cf11cb68f89c270aed283b1d46ea59ff770833/packages/playwright-test/types/test.d.ts#L2961-L2966
However, that doesn't make much sense in context; `expect.not` is supposed to invert a matcher.

Workaround: cast `expect` as `any` (losing all type information).  As it is actually present in the underlying library, this actually works at runtime.

review_comments: BaseExpect repeats the 3 lines above, let's pick one. I prefer inlining instead of a separate type :)

To have it easier in the future, I aligned it like the expect types are upstream. Thats why there is a separate type:

https://github.com/facebook/jest/blob/fd4bfbdb1f8f7620c9da543bd68c2251bd347cdb/packages/expect/src/types.ts#L78-L93
I'd prefer to include `any` and `anything` around line 3096 instead of omitting here.

This is the same as upstream:

https://github.com/facebook/jest/blob/fd4bfbdb1f8f7620c9da543bd68c2251bd347cdb/packages/expect/src/types.ts#L87-L93
